task_title: AUG-130 verified: a gate whose required arm did not run exits non-zero, the opt-in escape is loud, and a test drives gate.sh under a no-pytest shim
task_criteria: Whole self-test passes on the judged tree: tests/test_gate_mode.sh exits 0 and prints both 'AUG-081 wrapper regression: PASS' and 'AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS' (measured 17.5s). The file drives tests/gate.sh as a subprocess under a PATH shim whose python3 refuses `-c 'import pytest'`: the strict run must exit non-zero naming 'GATE FAIL: required arms did not run' and must never print 'GATE PASS'; the run with AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS=1 must exit 0 printing 'GATE PASS (DEGRADED)', 'required arms NOT run: pytest' and 'NOT proof the suite ran'. FAILIF: the file exits non-zero, or either control line is missing from its output. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:$PATH bash tests/test_gate_mode.sh

The skipped-arm proof is reachable FROM THE GATE: tests/gate.sh invokes the self-test as its wrapper-regression arm, guarded by the AUGER_GATE_INNER=1 seam so an inner gate invocation does not recurse into its own harness. FAILIF: zero invocation lines, or more than one. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -n 'bash tests/test_gate_mode.sh' tests/gate.sh   # expect exactly 1 match, on the elif arm that runs the wrapper regression

CI cannot silently skip the arm: the workflow installs pytest so the gate's pytest arm runs on the runner instead of being skipped (row acceptance criterion 2). FAILIF: no 'pip install ... pytest' line exists in the workflow file. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -Eq 'pip install .*pytest' .github/workflows/ci.yml && echo CI-INSTALLS-PYTEST

The strict verdict lives in the gate SCRIPT, not only in its test: tests/gate.sh contains the required-skip failure string, the documented opt-in escape, the DEGRADED pass header and the 'required arms NOT run' summary line. FAILIF: any of those four literals is missing from tests/gate.sh. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && python3 -c "import sys; s=open('tests/gate.sh').read(); ok=all(x in s for x in ['GATE FAIL: required arms did not run','AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS=1','GATE PASS (DEGRADED)','required arms NOT run']); print('STRICT-POLICY-OK' if ok else 'STRICT-POLICY-MISSING'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

items.criterion: The strict verdict lives in the gate SCRIPT, not only in its test: tests/gate.sh contains the required-skip failure string, the documented opt-in escape, the DEGRADED pass header and the 'required arms NOT run' summary line. items.detail: PROOF command printed STRICT-POLICY-OK, rc=0. In source: tests/gate.sh:388 'GATE PASS (DEGRADED)', :389 'required arms NOT run: $REQUIRED_SKIPPED', :390 'AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS=1 accepted this run. This is NOT proof the suite ran:', :395 'GATE FAIL: required arms did not run: $REQUIRED_SKIPPED' followed by exit 1 at :398; the required-skip recorder is skip_required_arm at :124 and is used for pytest at :228.

items.criterion: The AUGER_GATE_INNER=1 seam actually prevents recursion: an inner gate invocation (AUGER_GATE_INNER=1) must not invoke tests/test_gate_mode.sh, while the outer gate still runs it.
items.detail: Manual inner run (AUGER_GATE_INNER=1 AUGER_CI=1 GITHUB_ACTIONS=true under the no-pytest shim) printed `SKIPPED [wrapper-regression]: AUGER_GATE_INNER=1 — inner gate invocation from tests/test_gate_mode.sh; the outer gate runs this arm` (tests/gate.sh:243-250) and its output contained no 'AUG-081 wrapper regression: PASS', i.e. the harness was not re-entered. The outer gate does run it: full `AUGER_CI=1 GITHUB_ACTIONS=true bash tests/gate.sh` log shows '== wrapper regression (AUG-081) ==' then 'AUG-081 wrapper regression: PASS' and 'AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS'.

items.criterion: The strict failure path is non-vacuous: under the no-pytest shim the gate's pytest arm is genuinely skipped via skip_required_arm "pytest", and the non-zero exit is caused by that required skip rather than an unrelated arm failing.
items.detail: Manual strict run output: line 6 `SKIPPED [pytest]: pytest not importable by python3 (pip install pytest) — suite arm NOT run, NOT passed` (tests/gate.sh:228 skip_required_arm), line 29 `GATE FAIL: required arms did not run: pytest` — pytest is the ONLY entry in REQUIRED_SKIPPED, so the failure is attributable to it; STRICT_RC=1. The degraded run of the same tree exits 0 with `required arms NOT run: pytest`, confirming the skip is the sole cause.

items.criterion: The opt-in escape is not silently inherited: the strict run unsets AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS so an outer DEGRADED run cannot make the strict control pass, and the escape only applies when explicitly set to 1.
items.detail: tests/test_gate_mode.sh:426-437 run_inner_gate invokes `env -u AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS ... "$@"`, and the degraded case passes AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS=1 explicitly after the unset (:458). tests/gate.sh:387 accepts the escape only when `${AUGER_ALLOW_SKIPPED_ARMS:-0}` = "1". Verified by hand: with the variable unset the gate exits 1; with =1 it exits 0 printing GATE PASS (DEGRADED).

items.criterion: The gate's own wrapper-regression arm still passes on the judged tree: bash tests/gate.sh reaches the arm and it succeeds (no regression from the new invocation).
items.detail: Full gate run `AUGER_CI=1 GITHUB_ACTIONS=true bash tests/gate.sh` completed: pytest '717 passed, 2 skipped in 881.19s', then log line 15 '== wrapper regression (AUG-081) ==', line 18 'AUG-081 wrapper regression: PASS', line 19 'AUG-130 skipped-arm policy: PASS', line 40 'GATE PASS' (only pytest-live and e2e-smoke skipped, both declared live arms).
